en.answer:
You cannot apply the effect of <<15726>>.

That effect can only be applied if a face-up Level 3 or lower Zombie monster(s) you control would be destroyed.
en.question: A <<6341>> in face-down Defense Position on my field would be destroyed by the effect of <<4342>>. Can I apply the effect of <<15726>> and discard it instead?
en.title: If my face-down <<6341>> would be destroyed by a card effect, can I discard <<15726>> instead?
